items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: I heard Kit Orrie band with Donald Howard... I've heard Donald Howard several times since on record

ctx.x: What about Kit Orrie's band and what Kerry and those people, did they have any influence out there? Well, yes, they had a great influence on me.

I heard very early in the piece, I heard Kit Orrie band with Donald Howard, a session they made there, and I don't know why, I've heard Donald Howard several times since on record and he hasn't been impressive at all. On that particular record he was very impressive. I was particularly struck by it. In fact, I would say that probably, now I'm thinking of the answers to much earlier questions, Rod Kless with the Maxi Spania band was a strong influence on me because the Spania records were just coming out, I'd rush…
And high school then, what we call high school.
